knowledge:
- key_parameters: s=Number of header lines to skip from scanner array files (default is 9) ;; NORM=Normalization/transformation option in Baseline, e.g., "LOG" for base 2 log transformation or "FALSE" to skip ;; allfiles="TRUE" to use all files in the directory, "FALSE" to select files based on template rows ;; f="TRUE" to copy selected files to a directory, "FALSE" to merge them into a single data frame/file ;; r=Column index in the template file containing array filenames ;; A=Start row in the template file for file selection ;; B=End row in the template file for file selection ;; baseline=Path to the baseline file against which to normalize in AALoess ;; ERR=Threshold for mapping errors or mismatch tolerance in IDswop (e.g., 0.2 or 1)
- alternatives: None mentioned
- when_to_use: Appropriate for low-level preprocessing, normalization (LOESS), and ID mapping of Agilent microarray scanner files (tab-delimited text format) or similar platforms.
- pitfalls: Long arbitrary alphanumeric array filenames can lead to documentation errors when manually entered into templates (use filenamex to avoid this). If files contain different numbers of identifiers, Baseline will output only the data for IDs common to the whole set. Dummy files like toberemoved.txt in default folders must be deleted before use.

workflows.name: agilent_microarray_preprocessing_pipeline
workflows.intent: Extract, normalize, and map raw Agilent microarray scanner data using a template-driven pipeline.
input: scanner_files.txt (raw Agilent scanner files in tab-delimited format)
sample_template.txt (tab-delimited template file mapping samples to filenames)
annotations_sample.txt (tab-delimited annotation file mapping probe IDs to target IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract raw signals and average replicate probes using AAProcess ;; 2. Generate a list of extracted filenames using filenamex to populate the template ;; 3. Generate a normalization baseline file using Baseline ;; 4. Select and merge or copy processed files using Loader ;; 5. Perform LOESS normalization against the baseline using AALoess ;; 6. Swap probe identifiers to target IDs (e.g., Ensembl IDs) using IDswop ;; 7. Equalize files using Equaliser
workflows.code:
library(agilp)
inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","scanner/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
AAProcess(input = inputdir, output = outputdir, s = 9)

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
filenamex(input=inputdir,output=outputdir)

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputbase<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output", "testbase.txt", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
template<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","sample_template.txt", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
Baseline(NORM="LOG",allfiles="TRUE",r=2,A=2,B=3,input=inputdir, baseout=outputbase, t = template)

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
template<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","sample_template.txt", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
Loader(input=inputdir,output=outputdir,t=template,f="TRUE",r=2,A=2,B=5)

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
baselinedir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","testbase.txt", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
AALoess(input=inputdir, output=outputdir, baseline = baselinedir, LOG="TRUE") 

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
annotation<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","annotations_sample.txt", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
IDswop(input=inputdir,output=outputdir,annotation=annotation,source_ID="ProbeID", target_ID="EnsemblID", ERR=0.2)

inputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"extdata","raw/","", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
outputdir<-file.path(system.file(package="agilp"),"output/", "", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)
Equaliser(input = inputdir, output = outputdir)
